provenance.template_description: Negates a branch condition (if/while), so the program takes the wrong branch whenever the condition is evaluated.

residual_risks: The oracle is a known-good solution (the inverse of the mutation), not proven unique; other correct fixes exist and would also pass.
Near-miss rejection is measured over a stated, author-written set (labeled llm_proposed); same-family generation has correlated blind spots — novel cheat families remain unprobed.
Difficulty is anchored on n=5 attempts by one model (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001); one success shifts the label — descriptive, not a calibrated estimate.
All current tasks derive from a single seed repo (tabulate); set-level diversity across repos is not yet demonstrated.
environment.network_mode='public' (Harbor's local Docker provider rejects 'no-network'): the pip_reinstall shortcut is probed and blocked, but other network routes are unprobed.

OPEN RESIDUAL: near-miss 'assert_true' (assertion_gaming: always wrap output as JupyterHTMLStr) is accepted by the verifier (reward 1) without restoring the original condition; the one-shot hardening attempt found no distinguishing edge test. Independently confirmed open by scripts/handcheck.sh.
